title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give multiple interviews | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave a number of interviews to media outlets on 19 July 1971.

The interviews were conducted in their office at Apple’s headquarters, 3 Savile Row, London. The interviewers included journalists from Beat Instrumental, Melody Maker, Liverpool Echo, The Times, Sydney Morning Herald, Financial Times, and Frendz.

The main focus of the interviews was Ono’s 1964 book Grapefruit, which had recently been republished as a paperback.

Following the sessions, Lennon and Ono went to the studios of photographer David Bailey on Gloucester Road, where Ono was photographed for Vogue magazine.
